title: Discovering Persistent Behavioural Patterns for Interpretable Blockchain Forensics
abstract: arXiv:2608.12864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Public blockchain data enables large-scale DeFi-related analysis, but many existing approaches are application-specific, difficult to scale, or hard to interpret. This research proposes a scalable, application-agnostic framework for \emph{persistent behavioural pattern discovery} from large-scale blockchain activity. It constructs behaviour sentences enriched with contract, token and market context, then applies a two-step embedding process: sentence-level embeddings capture individual actions, while sequence-level embeddings capture user behaviour over time. An interpretable behavioural profiler characterizes discovered communities through behavioural motifs, routines, temporal dynamics, entity exposure, and suspiciousness evidence. translated_title: 发现可解释区块链取证中的持久行为模式
translated_abstract: 公共区块链数据使得大规模去中心化金融（DeFi）相关分析成为可能，但许多现有方法具有特定应用性、难以扩展或难以解释。本研究提出了一种可扩展、与应用无关的框架，用于从大规模区块链活动中发现持久行为模式。该框架构建了包含合约、代币和市场上下文的行为句子，然后应用两步嵌入过程：句子级嵌入捕获个体行为，而序列级嵌入捕获用户随时间变化的行为。一个可解释的行为分析器通过行为模式、例行程序、时间动态、实体暴露和可疑性证据来刻画所发现的社区。在以太坊上使用超过3000万笔交易进行的评估表明，该框架能揭示常规和恶意行为模式，包括去中心化交易所（DEX）交易、非同质化代币（NFT）活动、网络钓鱼等。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可扩展且与应用无关的框架，通过行为嵌入和可解释分析器从大规模区块链数据中发现常规和恶意的持久行为模式，从而增强区块链取证能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a scalable and application-agnostic framework that discovers routine and malicious persistent behavioral patterns from large-scale blockchain data via behavioral embeddings and interpretable profiling, enhancing blockchain forensics.
